versions.changelog:
- Initial release of pdf2word-review skill.
- Converts PDF to editable Word documents.
- Automatically audits conversion quality using a four-way reconciliation (character count, table count, image count, table-cell count) and includes a page-count reference.
- Clearly reports any differences or content loss between PDF and Word outputs, with detailed plain-language explanations.
- Supports OCR for scanned PDFs; guides user to install missing dependencies if needed.
- Provides both summary and detailed reporting, including optional HTML visual diff.
